# Pyn

> Pyn is an employee journey automation platform that delivers personalized communications and experiences across critical HR moments through HRIS integration and multi-channel delivery.

Pyn helps organizations automate and personalize the employee experience from onboarding through lifecycle moments, with integrations for Slack, Teams, and major HRIS systems. Founded by Joris Luijke and Jon Williams, the platform focuses on enabling managers, improving internal communications, and driving employee engagement through intelligent automation.

## Key Topics

- Employee Journey Automation
- HRIS Integration
- Employee Onboarding
- Employee Communications
- Manager Development
- Slack & Teams Integration
- Employee Engagement
- HR Automation
- Internal Communications
- Employee Experience

## Core Product Features

- [Product Overview](https://www.pynhq.com/product): Pyn employee journey automation platform with HRIS integration and multi-channel delivery
- [Employee Journey Mapping](https://www.pynhq.com/product/employee-journey-map): Pyn Employee Journey Designer tool for mapping employee experience and onboarding
- [Automated Employee Onboarding](https://www.pynhq.com/product/onboarding): Pyn automated onboarding with Slack, Teams, and HRIS integration capabilities
- [Company Internal Communications](https://www.pynhq.com/product/company-communications): Pyn internal communications platform with personalization and multi-channel delivery
- [Employee Lifecycle Automation](https://www.pynhq.com/product/lifecycle): Pyn employee lifecycle automation covering moments that matter in employee journey
- [Automated Support for Managers](https://www.pynhq.com/product/manager-development-and-enablement): Pyn manager development automation with coaching and learning enablement features
- [Sales & Support Performance](https://www.pynhq.com/product/sales-and-support): Pyn sales and support enablement for team ramp-up and performance management
